comparison.objective: Remove a flashlight battery for recycling after unscrewing its threaded tail cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a cylindrical body, follow a collision-modeled thread through about one turn, set down the cap, and tip out the cell.
comparison.success_condition: Cap genuinely unscrewed and placed, battery in the bin, flashlight returned and released; forced thread separation or dropped parts fail.
comparison.reason: Both include bimanual rotary manipulation, but this record tests threaded disassembly and gravity-assisted extraction. The candidate loosens only a captive lock, adjusts and relocks a collar, then tunes dynamic stopping performance.
